title: Tensor sections of one inverse-image affine chart
statement: Let $A,T$ be commutative rings, $X,Y$ schemes [def-pc-scheme], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$, $M$ a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent], and $U$ an affine open of $X$. Let $q:A\to T$, $p:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}A$, and $e:Y\simeq\operatorname{Spec}T$ satisfy $\operatorname{Spec}(q)\circ e=p$. Put $Z=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}Y$ and $G=\operatorname{tensorPullback}(\operatorname{pr}_X)M$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. There exists an affine open $W$ of $Z$, whose underlying open is exactly $\operatorname{pr}_X^{-1}(U)$, and a $T$-linear equivalence $T\otimes_A\Gamma(U,M)\simeq\Gamma(W,G)$. On $\Gamma(U,M)$ the $A$-action comes from $f$. On $\Gamma(W,G)$ the $T$-action comes from the composite $T\simeq\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}T,\mathcal O)\to\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O)\to\Gamma(W,\mathcal O)$ induced by $e$ and the second projection. No flatness, covering, or finiteness is assumed.

proof.text: Construct W as the inverse-image open of U. Since Y and Spec A are affine, p is affine; its base change, the first projection, is affine. Hence W is affine. Put B=O(U), C=O(W). The affine cartesian sections formula is a pushout square of rings. Transport the upper corners by the canonical spectrum-sections isomorphism and by e.hom.appTop to obtain the pushout A -> B, A -> T, B -> C, T -> C. The equation he and naturality of GammaSpecIso verify the base map. This is the affine-spectrum fibre-product formula on sections.

Apply exists_tensorPullback_affine_sections to the first projection, U, and the constructed W. Its bijective B-linear comparison c:N tensor_B C -> G(W) is also C-linear for the transported right-factor action. Swap tensor factors and use that C-linearity to make a bijective C-linear map C tensor_B N -> G(W).

Interpret the ring pushout as Algebra.IsPushout. Its cancellation equivalence identifies C tensor_B N with T tensor_A N as T-modules. Compose its inverse with the previous C-linear equivalence restricted to T. The scalar towers are induced by the section maps and the pushout equality, so the resulting equivalence uses precisely the displayed T-action.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affine_pullback_chart_tensor_sections
    (A T : CommRingCat.{u}) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec A)
    (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (U : X.affineOpens)
    (q : A ⟶ T) (p : Y ⟶ Spec A) (e : Y ≅ Spec T)
    (he : e.hom ≫ Spec.map q = p) :
    ∃ W : (pullback f p : Scheme.{u}).affineOpens,
      W.1 = (pullback.fst f p) ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 ∧
      (letI : Module (A : Type u) Γ(M, U.1) :=
        Module.compHom _ (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv ≫
          f.appLE ⊤ U.1 (by simp)).hom)
       letI : Algebra (A : Type u) (T : Type u) := q.hom.toAlgebra
       letI : Module (T : Type u)
           Γ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f p)).obj M, W.1) :=
         Module.compHom _ (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso T).inv ≫ e.hom.appTop ≫
           (pullback.snd f p).appLE ⊤ W.1 (by simp)).hom)
       Nonempty (((T : Type u) ⊗[(A : Type u)] Γ(M, U.1)) ≃ₗ[(T : Type u)]
         Γ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f p)).obj M, W.1)))
